summary: Interpreted the executed restart/durable-vote experiment (CheckRun a636b70ead1e45ebaf3c5d0edcd6dde7, exit 0, tests_passed). Parsed index 0 shows the antecedent producer edge (a real RequestVote granted to candidate A in term 6 left LastVoteTerm=6/LastVoteCand=A); parsed index 1 shows the durable vote and current term survived the restart, but at term 7 rather than the probe term 6, because the subject stayed a live cluster member whose real peers advanced it; parsed index 2's three denials were therefore decided by the older-term rule alone, so the same-term duplicate branch after restart was never exercised. Recorded as unresolved (defect_claim unresolved) instead of support or refutation, with limitations stating the isolation design flaw and a successor discriminator that isolates the target's transport (or uses unreachable co-voters) and confirms the restored term equals the probe term before comparing the same-candidate, other-candidate and older-term grants.
